positive/.env.production:1:7  warning  EG015 unsafe-production-value  DEBUG must be false in production but is on (positive/.env.production)
  variable: DEBUG
  why: The schema (.envguard.yaml:14) constrains DEBUG in production; violating it usually means a development or test setting is about to be deployed.
  fix: Set `DEBUG=false` in positive/.env.production.
  related: .envguard.yaml:14:3
  docs: https://github.com/ardamoustafa1/envguard/blob/main/docs/rules/EG015-unsafe-production-value.md
positive/.env.production:2:11  warning  EG015 unsafe-production-value  APP_DEBUG is enabled in production (positive/.env.production)
  variable: APP_DEBUG
  why: Laravel debug mode in production exposes stack traces, settings and sometimes an interactive console to anyone who triggers an error.
  fix: Set `APP_DEBUG=false` in positive/.env.production.
  docs: https://github.com/ardamoustafa1/envguard/blob/main/docs/rules/EG015-unsafe-production-value.md

positive/.env.production:8:14  warning  EG015 unsafe-production-value  DATABASE_URL points to a local address in production (positive/.env.production)
  variable: DATABASE_URL
  why: Inside a production container or server, localhost is the machine itself, not your database or API; this is almost always a development value that slipped through.
  fix: Set DATABASE_URL in positive/.env.production to the production host.
  docs: https://github.com/ardamoustafa1/envguard/blob/main/docs/rules/EG015-unsafe-production-value.md
